turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². How many sensitive areas of category 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION' have their polygon centroid inside the Voronoi cell of the Central station (station_id 16)? Return the count.
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Check size of relevant sensitive-area subset, then compute Central station's bbox-clipped Voronoi cell and count school centroids inside it.
precheck = pd.read_sql(text("""
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS educational_institution_count
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
"""), engine)

result = pd.read_sql(text("""
WITH station_pts AS (
    SELECT id, coordinate::geometry AS geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(geom)) AS geom
    FROM station_pts
),
vor AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom), 0.0, (SELECT geom FROM bbox)))).geom AS geom
    FROM station_pts
),
central_cell AS (
    SELECT ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.geom) AS geom
    FROM vor v
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
    WHERE ST_Contains(v.geom, (SELECT geom FROM station_pts WHERE id = 16))
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1000000.0 AS central_cell_area_km2,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)::int
            FROM sensitive_area sa, central_cell c
            WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
              AND ST_Contains(c.geom, ST_Centroid(sa.geometry))
        ) AS school_centroid_count
    FROM central_cell
)
SELECT ROUND(central_cell_area_km2::numeric, 6) AS central_cell_area_km2,
       school_centroid_count
FROM metrics
"""), engine)

central_cell_schools = int(result.loc[0, "school_centroid_count"])
print({
    "educational_institution_total": int(precheck.loc[0, "educational_institution_count"]),
    "central_cell_area_km2": float(result.loc[0, "central_cell_area_km2"]),
    "central_cell_schools": central_cell_schools
})
